hints.content:
The function is increasing, so the left Riemann sum will underestimate the actual area:


![The graph of function h has the shaded area divided into 4 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top left corner and is below the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/be34adca9a3761ddad9db9b648de47ff3462716e)

And the right Riemann sum will overestimate:

![The graph of function h has the shaded area divided into 4 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top right corner and rises above the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/3b27a5d28b33bd924aebbb5ab01d21cca55e69d1)

Here are the areas ordered from least to greatest:

* Left Riemann sum
* Actual area under the curve
* Right Riemann sum
